description.en: Makes a match member learn a technique/skill by ID, looked up by team slot and character ID. If notify is true (or omitted) and the member has a free skill slot, also records the new skill as "just learned" for the in-match learning popup.
Index of the team/side the character belongs to.
Character ID string identifying which member learns the skill.
Optional flag (defaults to true/notify); pass 0 to skip flagging the skill for the learning popup.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if fewer than 3 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Teach a match member a new technique without triggering the learning popup
CMND_BTL_LEARNING_SKILL(0, "para_cp0010", "whs0035", 0);
